title: Dog Art Exhibition in London
content: There's an exhibition of dog art this summer in London all summer which includesThe Old Shepherd's Chief Mournerby Edwin Landseer andBrizoby Rosa Bonheur.Brizoby Rosa Bonheur‘Portraits of Dogs: From Gainsborough to Hockney’ will be on display at The Wallace Collection from 29 March to 15 October 2023
